fair_value_policy: Fair Value V2.1 is the sole valuation baseline. Semantic scores must not directly overwrite official numeric macro series or Fair Value.

events.observed_evidence: Reuters reported that Hormuz commodity-vessel transits fell to seven on September 9 versus a 10-day average of 14, with no LNG tanker transit recorded. Iran-aligned Houthis seized Yemen's Mocha port, adding risk around the Bab el-Mandeb route. Brent settled September 10 at $107.63/bbl and WTI at $102.48/bbl, both above $100.
events.semantic_interpretation: The shock has broadened from a Hormuz-only disruption into a simultaneous Persian Gulf and Red Sea routing risk. Taiwan transmission remains negative through imported energy, freight/insurance, inflation and higher global yields; shipping operators may benefit from higher freight rates while energy-intensive and duration-sensitive sectors face margin/valuation pressure.

events.observed_evidence: Reuters reported major Russian attacks on Ukrainian logistics and economic infrastructure on September 10, including strikes in the industrial and rail hub of Pavlohrad and a Bunge sunflower-oil facility in Dnipro; separate sea-drone attacks hit Sochi in Russia.
events.semantic_interpretation: The pattern indicates continued economic-infrastructure targeting rather than de-escalation. Direct Taiwan exposure is limited, but persistence raises European demand, commodity and risk-premium uncertainty.
